faq.q: Can I use the QR code offline?
faq.a: Yes. The code is generated on your device and the downloaded PNG or SVG works anywhere, because the data is inside the image itself.

faq.q: Why does the code have a blank margin?
faq.a: That blank border is the quiet zone scanners need to find the code. Removing it or placing the code on a busy background is the most common reason a QR code fails to scan.

faq.q: Which download format should I use?
faq.a: PNG for social posts, slides and print up to poster size. SVG for logos, laser cutting or anything that will be scaled and must stay sharp.
